title: One-step simulation by a tagged machine
statement: Let $d,K\in\bbn$, let $S_j$ be a state type for each of the $d$ indices, and let $M_j$ be a $K$-work-tape deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and state type $S_j$. For every Boolean input $x$, index $j<d$, and configuration $c$ of $M_j$ on $x$, one step of the combined machine from the configuration tagging $c$ with $j$ equals the configuration obtained by taking one step of $M_j$ from $c$ and tagging the result with $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A state type $S_j$ for each of the $d$ indices
A family of machines $M_j$ with $K$ work tapes, Boolean alphabet, and state type $S_j$
